mistakes.symptom: Agent used command syntax or path conventions from the wrong shell family.
mistakes.correction: Detect the active shell and render commands for that shell before execution.

mistakes.symptom: Agent repeatedly failed to read or search files due to quoting, encoding, or path handling assumptions.
mistakes.correction: Use the platform adapter's preferred read and search commands instead of assuming portable shell behavior.

mistakes.symptom: Agent used an integration surface that did not match the maintainer's expected workflow.
mistakes.correction: Prefer the configured local tool or adapter for the operation; use connector tools only when the local path is unavailable or explicitly requested.

mistakes.symptom: Agent picked the wrong GitHub transport for PR create/view/check/comment operations.
mistakes.correction: Follow the repo's configured GitHub transport preference, such as local gh CLI first or connector-first when explicitly configured.

mistakes.symptom: Agent used configuration or API patterns from an older major version of a framework or tool.
mistakes.correction: Before editing framework configuration, inspect installed package versions and current primary docs; do not assume older major-version setup still applies.

mistakes.symptom: Agent passed a PowerShell range expression as a string to Select-Object -Index.
mistakes.correction: Wrap PowerShell ranges in parentheses, for example Select-Object -Index (108..156).

mistakes.symptom: Agent tried to run Playwright before the package or workspace runtime was available.
mistakes.correction: Inspect the repo package manager and installed dependencies before loading Playwright; install dependencies or use the bundled runtime path when the project expects it.
